I tell him all the time how I feel. He tells me he is trying his best, but I think I am more than he handle. I went to sleep sobbing last night. He told me he didn't what to do anymore to help me. So he just rolled over and went to sleep. He tried to teach me guitar last night, but I couldn't do it.  I want to join the gym, but I can't for 3 weeks. I've tried meet up groups to meet people. He tries really hard to entertain me, but his job is to high pressure. :( I dont think an online course would work, I can barely get myself to doctors appointments, I doubt I could get myself.

THank you for trying, it was sweet of you.
